2014: I graduated from college! I was super ready to finally start my career! But, then nothing. Nothing at all. So I got an internship as a Graphic Designer. I "interned" with them for 2 months, then they stole my designs and fired me. They soon went under so whatever.

2013: Mind you while all this shit is going on, the main that I have to fall back on was my wife and video games. Well, I left IKEA, then went to work at the women's clothing store, Anthropolgie, as a Visual Merchandiser. Admittedly, that was a pretty fun gig.

I eventually came across this job listing on Craig's List for a photo-booth technician for . I had 0 experience, but they took me in, and were willing to show me the ropes and teach me! Knowing that I was looking for something more stable they gave me gigs...

2015: I "sort of" got my 1st official big boy job! It was still for retail. decided to give me a chance. Even though it was for retail, I was starting at $20 an hour and full-time. So I was completely fine with having "retail" in my title at this time.

I fell completely out of love with clothing and that industry, but I felt myself gravitating more and more to the entertainment industry. So I gave up on Laire. I know a year later, I was just over the work that I was putting in and the return that I was getting back.

2016: I proposed to my wife! I was engaged for 2 years, so you can say that I was balling on a budget. I also got a promotion at Apple too. But, something felt completely off and I didn't quite know what it was.
